title: chezmoi dashboard data
description: Shape of .chezmoidata/dashboard.yaml -- presentation, logins and buttons for OliveTin. Structure only: tools/check-consistency is what cross-references tile keys against endpoints.

groups.description: Fieldset render order. A tile whose group is not listed here lands in the trailing ungrouped fieldset.

tiles.description: Keyed by endpoint name. An endpoint with no entry still gets a plain tile.

label.description: Display name. Defaults to the endpoint name.

icon.description: Iconify name, `prefix:name`, from https://icon-sets.iconify.design -- `selfhst:` covers most self-hosted apps. The template wraps it in <iconify-icon>. A name that does not exist renders blank, so check it before adding.

users.description: OliveTin local logins. The password hash itself lives in 1Password, never here.

group.description: Which ACL applies. Both names are hard-coded in config.yaml.tmpl.

oneOf.description: Every action, including ones added later.

secret.description: Field name in the `olivetin` 1Password item holding the argon2id hash. Must be inside a section.

actions.description: Buttons. Adding one is a data edit; the template ranges over this list.

title.description: OliveTin's identity for the action -- must be unique.

icon.description: Iconify name, `prefix:name`. The template wraps it in <iconify-icon>.

timeout.description: Seconds. OliveTin kills the command past this.

confirm.description: Adds a confirmation argument before it runs.

family.description: true also grants the `family` ACL. admins always have it.

popup.description: true shows the command's stdout in a modal as it runs, instead of leaving it behind a click through to the logs. For informational buttons.

group.description: Which Controls fieldset this button sits in. Must appear in `action_groups`.

role.description: Only render this action on a host with this role. Omit for actions that work anywhere.

argument.description: A dropdown. Reference the value from `shell` as OliveTin's own {{ name }} placeholder.

choices_from.description: Where the choices come from -- a named source, never a literal list, so the values cannot drift from the data that defines them.

action_groups.description: Fieldset order on the Controls dashboard. An action whose `group` is not listed here renders nowhere -- check-consistency C15.
